body:
Superseded by #106 per the 2026-07-14 lineup ruling (executive-desk decision 0006, Proposal C as amended).

What survives into #106: the generated plugin README (to the readme-value-and-proof standard) and the honest plugin description. What's dropped: the `pw-` mass rename (churns the hottest muscle-memory commands — handoff fired ~35 times in the two-week evidence window under its current name — for naming cosmetics) and the router skill (a capability-add with no evidenced confusion to solve; fails the stabilization litmus and the use-case-pull gate).

Evidence: the adversarially verified usage sheet on the executive desk (dev-tooling-desk/_meta/research/usage-evidence-2026-07-14.md). If a real naming collision or routing failure ever surfaces, a smaller issue can be refiled against the trimmed roster with that incident as its use case.
